cover_crop: winter cereals (7 rye, 2 triticale, 3 wheat cultivars)
comparison: winter cereal cover crop (average of 12 cultivars) vs. no cover crop check, no-till corn after soybean
metric: corn grain yield, 4-year mean (cover crop average)
quote: Corn grain yield (Mg ha–1) following 12 cover crop small grain cultivars and a no cover crop check in four years (n = 3). None No cover crop check 12.21a* 11.90a 12.20ns 13.19ns 12.38a ... Cover crop average 11.35B 11.53B 11.89B 13.20A 11.99
note: Table 6. Check 4-yr mean 12.38 Mg ha-1 vs cover crop mean 11.99 -> -0.39 Mg ha-1 (about -3.2%), computed by extractor. Authors caution that the significant cultivar x year interaction makes 4-yr averages hard to interpret. Quote joins the table caption, check row and cover-crop-average row with '...' (whitespace normalized from tab-separated table).

comparison: winter cereal cover crop vs. no cover crop check, 2006
quote: In 2006 the average corn grain yield following cover crops was 0.86 Mg ha–1 (13.7 bu ac–1) less than the no cover crop check, with corn yields signifi­cantly less than the check for 7 of the 12 cultivars.
note: Printed as '0.86 ... less than'; sign added. Check 12.21 vs cover avg 11.35 Mg ha-1 (about -7%). Cover crop terminated 27 Apr, corn planted 5 May.

comparison: winter cereal cover crop vs. no cover crop check, 2007
quote: In 2007 the corn yield difference between the average of the cover crop cultivars and the no cover crop check (–0.37 Mg ha–1 [–5.9 bu ac–1]) was smaller than in 2006.
note: Printed with en-dash minus. 5 of 12 cultivars significantly lower than check. Check 11.90 vs cover avg 11.53 (about -3%).

comparison: winter cereal cover crop vs. no cover crop check, 2008
quote: In 2008 the greatest numerical difference between the no cover crop check and one of the cover crop treatments was –0.69 Mg ha–1 (–11.0 bu ac–1) and the mean yield across all cover crop treatments was 11.89 Mg ha–1 (189 bu ac–1), which was 0.31 Mg ha–1 (4.9 bu ac–1) less than the no cover crop check.
note: Printed as '0.31 ... less than'; sign added. Difference not statistically significant.
